title: Experience beyond the code.
description: At SoftVence, I developed the communication and delivery skills to work with both clients and teammates. These are skills I bring into my next developer role.

stages.title: Clarify the brief.
stages.description: Working directly with clients taught me to ask useful questions, understand requirements, and contribute to a clear proposal and development plan.

stages.title: Keep the team aligned.
stages.description: I learned to explain technical decisions, share progress with clients and teammates, discuss feedback, and make blockers visible while developing and testing.

stages.title: Follow through on delivery.
stages.description: My experience includes explaining the product to the client, supporting handover and deployment, and helping with software fixes and improvements after delivery.
stages.result: A product the client can use and maintain.
